description: This PHP class defines 'TemplateEnum', a specialized form of 'TemplateText' for handling enumerated fields in SuiteCRM. It includes properties and methods for populating options, handling dependencies, rendering form elements, and retrieving field definitions within the CRM's framework.

classes.name: TemplateEnum
classes.description: A class extending TemplateText to provide enumeration field functionalities, including options management, dependency processing, and rendering for SuiteCRM fields.

methods.name: populateFromPost
methods.description: Populates the object properties from POST data, handling dependency arrays and JSON decoding of visibility grids.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Generates an array of variables for the edit view template, including options and help texts.

methods.name: get_xtpl_search
methods.description: Prepares template variables for search form, including current search value and options.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array, including options, default value, length, dependency, and visibility grid.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Retrieves the display value of the enum field for the detail view, handling special characters and app list strings.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the field, processing default values and visibility grids from string to array or JSON as needed.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the field, calling parent delete method.
